title: Affine pushforward and tensor modules commute with the directed limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], let $(S_i)$ be an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$. Fix $0\in I$ and write $g_i:S_i\to S_0$ ($i\ge0$) and $g:S\to S_0$ for the projections. Let $\mathcal F_0$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S_0}$-module [pqf-def-coherent], set $\mathcal A_i=(g_i)_*\mathcal O_{S_i}$, a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S_0}$-algebra, and let $\mathcal A=\varinjlim_{i\ge0}\mathcal A_i$ be the directed colimit of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S_0}$-algebras (whose underlying module is the colimit of the $\mathcal A_i$ in $\mathcal O_{S_0}$-modules). Then: (1) $S$ is identified over $S_0$ with the relative spectrum $\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S_0}(\mathcal A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec], so that $g_*\mathcal O_S\cong\mathcal A$; (2) there are canonical isomorphisms $(g_i)_*g_i^*\mathcal F_0\cong\mathcal F_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S_0}}\mathcal A_i$ and $g_*g^*\mathcal F_0\cong\mathcal F_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S_0}}\mathcal A$, compatible with the transition maps; (3) under these identifications, $\mathcal F_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S_0}}\mathcal A$ with the maps induced by $\mathcal A_i\to\mathcal A$ is the colimit of the directed system $(\mathcal F_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S_0}}\mathcal A_i)_{i\ge0}$ in the category of $\mathcal O_{S_0}$-modules.

proof.text: Restrict to the cofinal nonempty directed tail above i₀. Mathlib isAffineHom_π_app makes the supplied limit projection affine. Form the tail diagram in affine schemes over the fixed stage and its limiting cone (the full inclusion and Over.forget reflect limits). The relative-spectrum anti-equivalence takes its opposite cone to an algebra colimit. The quasi-coherent-algebra colimit theorem makes inclusion of quasi-coherent algebras preserve this colimit. Its object and sectionwise map formulas identify that diagram with the supplied A; uniqueness of colimits gives α, and the same formulas prove its specified leg equation. Affineness and the ring-sheaf isomorphism give the affine-chart IsIso assertion.

Construct the projection morphism F tensor f_*O_X → f_*f^*F by sheafifying the bilinear section map (t,a) ↦ a • η(t); linearity and compatibility with restriction follow from the unit being a module morphism. For an affine base open, its affine inverse image and the module-pullback affine-section theorem identify this map on pure tensors with a bijective tensor comparison. The quasi-coherent tensor-section theorem identifies its source sections with the section tensor product. The affine-basis criterion gives an isomorphism, with its formula on every open from the construction. Transport along the algebra isomorphism α, or hA for a stage.

The general directed sheaf-algebra colimit theorem constructs a cocone whose underlying module cocone is colimiting. This proves preservation of the given directed colimit by the underlying-module functor. The section hypotheses hBm and hbm identify the supplied B and b with that underlying diagram and cocone, giving IsColimit b. The algebra isomorphism α identifies c.pt.toModule with the affine pushforward of the structure sheaf, which is quasi-coherent by the relative-spectrum theorem. Transport quasi-coherence across the underlying module isomorphism. TensorLeft F preserves this colimit because the existing sheaf tensor–Hom adjunction exhibits it as a left adjoint.

For a transition or colimit leg, cancel the inverse of the source projection isomorphism against its hom on the input pure tensor. WhiskerLeft_app_tmulSection computes tensoring with the underlying module map. Substitute hBm or hbm and the target projection formula. This gives exactly the two compatibility equations in the conclusion. Assemble with the preceding quasi-coherence, affineness, algebra comparison and colimit statements.
